acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in the data-dependent mode. ... Selected Reaction Monitoring (SRM) was used to analyze the expression of wild-type EPHA2
cleavage agent: Digestion was performed with Lys-C (Wako 125-05061) (1% w:w enzyme:substrate) for 3 hours at 37°C, followed by addition of trypsin (Worthington) (1% w:w enzyme:substrate) for overnight digestion.
enrichment method: Dried peptide pellets were resuspended in TiO2 loading buffer (80% MeCN, 5% TFA, 1 M glycolic acid) and 3 mg Titansphere TiO2 beads (10 µm; GL-Sciences 5020 75010) were added per 500 µg peptides
fractionation method: High pH reverse phase chromatographic separation
High pH reverse phase chromatographic separation was performed on a Agilent Zorbax 300 extend – C18 column (4.6 X 150 mm, 3.5 μm)
fragmentation method: The 10 most abundant ions were selected for fragmentation by higher-energy collisional dissociation
instrument: Samples were resuspended in 0.1% FA and run on a LTQ Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) ... Samples were run on a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: By combining Stable Isotope Labeling by Amino acids in Cell culture (SILAC) and phosphoproteomic analysis
reduction reagent: proteins were reduced in 20 mM dithiothreitol (DTT)
